answer: Cheap clones never repay the bond before detection, so sybil farms collapse. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware root, and peers challenge with a proof-of-work puzzle tuned like splitting shale: every new reputation slot costs real compute plus forfeitable stake. Reputation accrues like lines of a sonnet, layer by layer, and a lone island of honest nodes can still verify the chain and slash fakes. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
